reviews.title: Would recommend!
reviews.contents:
Great app all around. It’s easy to use by sleep deprived people like myself. We found that the feeding tracking in particular helps us plan our time, because our baby feeds every 2 hours almost to the minute.
It would be nice if the app did not randomly pop up the windows with the feeding / sleep tracking prediction info because we don’t need it. Also would be nice if there was sleep tracking for mom too.

reviews.title: The new version of the app is terrible!
reviews.contents: I love the OLD Glow Baby! This version is complete garbage. Switch back to the old app! The new app is awful to navigate, doesn’t show me any of my milestone photos, doesn’t have the “awake time” which I relied on and isn’t as user friendly. So sad.

reviews.title: Great App... until the most recent update
reviews.contents: Yikes. What a disappointment. Glow went from being the best app we used for tracking our son’s sleep to a pain to use. We want information - not a social media experience. Also, increase in ads is not welcome.

reviews.title: Update decreased functionality
reviews.contents: Was loving this app before the recent update. Now you can no longer see at a glance on the home page how long baby has slept so far today, or how many wet/dirty diapers they've had, and the sleep tracker now counts from the last time they fell asleep instead of the last time they woke up (so it's not telling you how long they've been awake for like it used to). This is super annoying because these were some of the main things I regularly checked the app for. You can still figure this out for yourself in the analysis chart or in the timeline but it takes longer than a quick glance.

reviews.title: Hate the new update
reviews.contents: I would rate 5 stars I’ve been using this since my little one was born she is now 22 months but the newest update is Terrible I don’t like it

reviews.title: Bring back the old format!
reviews.contents: I used to use this app multiple times a day for tracking wake windows for my baby instead of trying to figure out how long he has been awake..now I don’t know if I will even continue using the app at all. I used to recommend it to all first time mothers because of its great functions. So disappointing.

reviews.title: Ruined a helpful app, removed functionality
reviews.contents:
The home page redesign is terrible, and has removed critical functionality that made this app useful. The home page used to display the latest logs l, which as a parent you often need to check 10x per day, especially when switching between caregivers. This is the primary function of the app. 

It also used to show much time had passed SINCE the last log - critical information for breastfeeding moms. The redesign has hidden all this information, and removed the ability to see the time since the last log. Which means it’s useless for breastfeeding.

I love that they added tracking for toddlers, especially for the growth charts, but everything else about the update is terrible and completely misunderstands why people use the app. The social media timeline look is only going to help them monetize if people still use the app! These changes make that a big question.

reviews.title: Old version is much better
reviews.contents: New version all the functions are very annoying to use

reviews.title: New update not as good
reviews.contents: Please bring back the awake timer that was on the main screen previously. Also, was able to previously view which side with last nursing, which was very helpful but now gone. Overall great app but the previous version much better.

reviews.title: Just...No
reviews.contents:
The new update isn’t great at all. I understand the want for change and the hard work but it’s definitely sacrificed efficiency for looks, there’s not much functionality to the app anymore. 

I just don’t understand where all the pictures I uploaded went, hate that you have to scroll down a timeline to find them instead of the beautiful place they were in last time, now it’s like their hidden. 
The sleep timer, why is it showing that my child slept “an hour ago” when he actually slept for 58 minutes and his nap ended 2 minutes ago. 
I think the look is nice but put the pictures back where they were, and change back the sleep timer to what it was. 

I like the added milestone-like options, just the confusion of the new update is not cool at all. Personally just upset, I love this app and this update just does not do it for me at all. Appreciate the added work and effort, just please change it back in a sense, I want to see my pictures more easily.
